executive_summary: [lab-host-20] Vulnerability assessment report for lab-flask-python running Werkzeug v2.2.2 on lab-host-20:5000/tcp, identifying multiple high-severity vulnerabilities including resource consumption and debugger security controls.

findings.title: Werkzeug v2.2.2 multipart form parsing resource consumption
findings.evidence: lab-host-20:5000/tcp running Werkzeug v2.2.2 (vulnerable to multipart form parsing issues leading to resource consumption).
findings.label: high

fired_rules.text: IF exposure is internet AND cvss is high THEN priority is high
IF cvss is high AND epss is low THEN priority is medium
IF criticality is high AND cvss is high THEN priority is high

findings.remediation: Upgrade Werkzeug to version 2.2.3 or later. Implement request limits and ensure proper handling of multipart form data. Source: MITRE CWE-770 Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling.
references: OWASP WSTG WSTG-APIT-06 API Rate Limiting and Resource Consumption: https://owasp.org/www-project-web-security-testing-guide/latest/16-API_Testing/06-API_Rate_Limiting_and_Resource_Consumption

findings.title: Werkzeug v2.2.2 multipart parsing and resource exhaustion
findings.evidence: lab-host-20:5000/tcp running Werkzeug v2.2.2 (exhibiting multipart parsing / resource exhaustion vulnerability characteristics).
findings.label: high

fired_rules.text: IF exposure is internet AND cvss is high THEN priority is high
IF cvss is high AND epss is low THEN priority is medium
IF criticality is high AND cvss is high THEN priority is high

findings.remediation: Upgrade Werkzeug to version 3.0.1+ (or patch level addressing uncontrolled resource consumption). Use resource-limiting settings provided by the operating system or environment, and control the allocation of limited request parsing buffers. Sources: MITRE CWE-400 Uncontrolled Resource Consumption and OWASP WSTG-APIT-06 API Rate Limiting and Resource Consumption.
references: OWASP WSTG WSTG-APIT-06 API Rate Limiting and Resource Consumption: https://owasp.org/www-project-web-security-testing-guide/latest/16-API_Testing/06-API_Rate_Limiting_and_Resource_Consumption

findings.title: Werkzeug v2.2.2 debugger vulnerability
findings.evidence: lab-host-20:5000/tcp running Werkzeug v2.2.2 (debugger vulnerability in affected versions).
findings.label: high

fired_rules.text: IF exposure is internet AND cvss is high THEN priority is high

findings.remediation: Upgrade Werkzeug to the latest patched version where debugger security controls are properly enforced. Ensure the development debugger is disabled in production environments. Implement robust anti-CSRF tokens and cookie validation checks for any sensitive state-changing requests. Sources: MITRE CWE-352 Cross-Site Request Forgery and OWASP WSTG-SESS-05 Cross Site Request Forgery.
